import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#95a5a6']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_gender[:len(gender_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(gender_counts))
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)')

# 4. Dog Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Filter valid age data and get unique values per dog
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
ax4.hist(age_data, bins=20, color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='white', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
ax4.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax4.axvline(age_data.median(), color='orange', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data.median():.1f} years')
ax4.legend()

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
